steps.content: The static on the other end pauses for a moment, as if at last confirming the signal has successfully gone through.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! Thank goodness... we finally got through... Are you alright?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The signal... isn't stable. I'll keep this brief.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Actually... you've been inside the Bureau this whole time.
The moment she says this, the entire team falls silent.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Wait, we're WHERE?!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: The... the Bureau?

Everyone there is stunned into silence. But you aren't particularly surprised. That elusive sense of familiarity has been surfacing over and over since earlier. It simply hasn't been clearly confirmed until this moment.

Three Hours Ago
Inside the MBCC Ring Substance Laboratory

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Beginning collision experiment number eleven.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Loading Ring substance.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Confirmed.
Stabilizer output normal.
Collider ring preheating complete. Ramping field strength.
Sample R-07. Preparing for injection.
Polarization orbit deployed. Transfer arm calibrating.
Parameters locked. Three, two, one. Contact.
[Screen Shakes]

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: What's going on?! Why is the field strength spiking?!

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Wait, the readings are off! The containment ring is destabilizing!

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Cut the transfer! Cut it now!

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Too late. The sample's breaking apart—

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Warning. Core parameters exceeded safety threshold.

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Collider ring structural integrity compromised.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: The experiment failed! M-values are completely uncontrollable! Not unless we can find a replacement sample!
Mania tore through the experiment center like a high-pressure valve ripped violently open, erupting beyond all containment.
But the truth was, the real loss of control had begun long before that moment.
Murphy's runaway car slammed into the Bureau's outer wall. The coin slipped from your grasp and rolled free. The brutal impact jolted open a maintenance hatch that had never been properly secured.
Behind that hatch, the backup circuits were yanked loose, their connections severed in an instant. The identification module responsible for routing samples hiccupped, triggering an error command.
The coin rolled clean through the hatch, gliding unimpeded all the way to the transfer track of the 11th collision experiment.

And at that same moment, the calibration arm, rattled by the cascading vibrations, drifted off by a few millimeters. The Mania field that should have already torn loose was delayed—by just a handful of seconds.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Wait... What is that?!
And it was precisely those few seconds that sent the coin bouncing right into the ring collider.
Immediately after, a pink miasma spread along the underground facility, engulfing the entire Bureau in the blink of an eye.
(Back to present)

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Mania field is severely disrupting your perception and cognition. It's warping and restructuring the Bureau's internal layout, projecting it as the world you're seeing now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The castle, the forest... everything around you essentially corresponds to different sections of the Bureau's underground facility.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe... well, that just makes it even more interesting.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: ...So we're basically people wandering around with VR headsets on, and everyone who didn't get caught up in the Mania is just watching us look like total idiots!

options: Don't worry, no one has time to laugh at you right now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The Ring Research Institute has preliminarily confirmed that this abnormal expansion of the Mania field is linked to the influence of Sinner Murphy.
Murphy's shoulders suddenly tense up.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: More precisely, the anomalous concept of her ability interfered with the Mania field. It warped what would have been a far more lethal, purer form of contamination into its current state.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Phew...Oh man, I was so scared. So... so you're saying the Mania that would've driven people insane, mutated them, or just... stopped their hearts? And now the worst it does is make people get chased by coin banks and slapped in the face by slimes?
Hearing the conclusion, Murphy lets out a long sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: So that means... I actually saved everyone? That counts as doing something good, right? Hehe.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The tradeoff, however, is that the Mania field's rate of spread has also been amplified.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: If left unchecked, this Mania field, with its severe cognitive distortion, risks spreading across the entire DisCity. Given enough time, all of DisCity will be shrouded in illusion.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Huh...? No way... I knew it...
Murphy's brief flash of relief lasts barely two minutes before she wilts once more, like a flower starved of sunlight.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All of DisCity?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. We need to act quickly to eliminate the substance that allowed Sinner Murphy to interfere with the Mania field in the first place.
From Nightingale's end comes the crisp sound of tapping, punctuated by the rustle of turning pages, as though she is carefully cross-referencing the latest intelligence that has just come in.

options: Can you send Sinner reinforcements to the Bureau underground?

steps.content: Nightingale goes quiet, unusually so.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Due to the Mania field's unusual properties, we can't directly intervene with it from above ground. The most we can do is slow its rate of expansion.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You'll need to locate that unstable experimental substance and neutralize its effects.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Once that's done, the Ring Research Institute will immediately attempt to recalibrate and restore the entire Mania field through an external experiment.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: So basically, we've gotta keep pushing forward on our own.
Right. The Mania field is too disrupted right now. For the time being, we can only rely on our own strength.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Correct.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Additionally, Chief, please be aware. Mania entities still exist within the Bureau. They don't currently pose a significant threat.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: However, we can't yet determine whether their threat level will escalate over time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Also—
She seems poised to add something more, but the transmission suddenly warps beyond recognition with a surge of static swallowing her voice whole.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Murphy is... one of the key factors... but she's also... the most susceptible...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief... you must...
The transmission cuts out, and all that remains is the hollow echo of static drifting through the empty corridor.
As everyone takes in the underground structure before them once more, it feels irrevocably changed.

The rough-hewn stone walls now seem to reveal the ghostly outlines of metal supports lurking just beneath their surface. EMP runs a hand along the stone and mutters that it's a good thing she held back earlier; otherwise, she'd definitely be on the hook for helping with the Bureau's repairs.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...I'm so embarrassed. Sniff... I came here to turn myself in at the Bureau, and now I've made this huge mess! Murphy, how could you?!
Beside you, Murphy sinks deeper into her own bitter thoughts, until at last she simply surrenders, dropping to the ground in a heap of defeat.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hey, look on the bright side. Just think of it as, y'know, step one of turning yourself in.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: But at least the goal's clear now... We need to keep going deeper, right?
At those words, her fingers curl into tight fists, and she turns her gaze toward everyone.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: ...Or maybe... you should just leave me here.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: It's confirmed now. The Mania turned out like this because of me. And we're gonna keep running into dangerous stuff like that giant coin bank...

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: If I keep following you guys, I'm just gonna make everything worse and drag down your combat strength.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: You were supposed to be dealing with the Mania, but instead you're stuck dragging around someone like me who just makes everything harder for everyone...
She trails off, her voice dropping to a murmur.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Okay, putting everything else aside—if you hadn't crashed into—uh, tripped and taken out that giant coin bank, we'd still be running from it right now.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Yeah... But I'll admit, that final moment was... a bit unexpected.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: That-that was just me being unlucky again. That's all...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Turning bad luck into something useful? That's a talent! Just like how I clawed my way to the top of Syndicate through cheating and trickery!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You get scared, you cause trouble, but when things get dangerous, you still charge forward anyway... Isn't that what a friend does?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: R-right! How could we just leave you behind all alone? I couldn't... I-I couldn't do that...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: And I mistook you for someone else before! Here, this is a photo I took just now. It's yours! Think of it as a memento of... um, our f-first time becoming friends! Is that okay...?
They speak up one by one, as if they are talking about something perfectly ordinary.
Murphy stares at them, dazed, listening to every single word. It takes a long, suspended moment before she can finally accept that she didn't mishear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Bureau handles incidents by resolving them, not by punishing Sinners. If there's anything that needs to be said, we'll talk about it in the interrogation room once we're out of here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're way more useful sticking with the team than wandering off on your own.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides... everyone here is your friend now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Me too.
At your words, a smile finally finds its way to her face.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Haha... You're all seriously weird, you know that?

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hehe, thanks for the compliment!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No one was complimenting you.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I'll take it anyway.
The tension eases at last. You cast your gaze deeper into the underground city, where that pink haze still roils and churns.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's get ready to move.
But now, you all know why you have to press forward—not just to clear some bizarre dungeon, but to restore the Bureau to the way it was.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Copy that.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Okay!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'll scout ahead with everything I've got!
This time, Murphy doesn't hesitate. She breaks into a light run to catch up.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: If this could be my everyday life... that wouldn't be so bad.
Unfortunately, she's still quite slow.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Wait for me!
But what she fails to notice is that, as she dashes forward, a shadowy figure identical to her is running off in the opposite direction.
It's you... Of all people, you again...
